fallbackDescription.en: Stop scrolling on Instagram Web: hide ads and suggestions, dim posts from accounts you do not follow, use grayscale mode, view a Reels timer and statistics, and enable Dark Mode.
fallbackDescription.zh: 停止在 Instagram 網頁版無意義滑動：隱藏廣告與推薦內容、淡化未追蹤貼文、灰階模式、Reels 計時器與統計、深色模式。

fallbackDescription.en: Hide YouTube search-history suggestions from the search dropdown without deleting or changing the underlying history.
fallbackDescription.zh: 隱藏 YouTube 搜尋下拉選單中的搜尋記錄建議，但不會刪除或修改實際記錄。

fallbackDescription.en: Queue follow-up prompts while ChatGPT is still responding.
fallbackDescription.zh: 在 ChatGPT 仍在回應時預先排隊後續提示，讓對話流程不中斷。

fallbackDescription.en: Track visited sites, dwell time, new-tab site opens, and the first site opened after browser startup.
fallbackDescription.zh: 記錄造訪的網站、停留時間、新分頁網站開啟次數，以及瀏覽器啟動後開啟的第一個網站。

fallbackDescription.en: Hide account-menu sign-out entries on Google and YouTube pages to reduce accidental sign-outs.
fallbackDescription.zh: 隱藏 Google 與 YouTube 帳戶選單中的登出項目，減少意外登出。

fallbackDescription.en: Reduce YouTube distractions with page-based toggles, multilingual popup controls, and watch-time tools.
fallbackDescription.zh: 透過依頁面分類的開關、多語言 popup 控制和觀看時間工具，減少 YouTube 干擾。

fallbackDescription.en: Professional video watch-time tracking with multiple metrics and historical reports.
fallbackDescription.zh: 以多種指標與歷史報告，專業追蹤不同網站的影片觀看時間。

fallbackDescription.en: Track, measure, and monitor video watch time through a real-time overlay timer with customizable display options.
fallbackDescription.zh: 透過可自訂顯示的即時浮動計時器，追蹤、量度及監察影片觀看時間。

fallbackDescription.en: Keep selected browser tabs up to date and monitor important page changes without manually reloading each page.
fallbackDescription.zh: 自動重新整理指定的瀏覽器分頁，並監察重要的頁面變化，無需逐頁手動重新載入。

fallbackDescription.en: A pure-black new-tab page displaying a random quote and author in 10 major languages.
fallbackDescription.zh: 純黑新分頁，顯示 10 種主要語言的隨機名言和作者。
